Our client is looking for a dedicated operator to join their dynamic team in Pittem.

As an  operator, you will be responsible for the entire carrot processing process within your line.

You will ensure that the installation runs optimally and continuously monitor the quality and efficiency.

Your tasks will include:

• Checking incoming carrots and correctly storing them in the bunkers

• Operating, monitoring, and adjusting the machines responsible for the entire peeling process

• Continuously monitoring the production process and intervening where necessary

• Taking responsibility for the process until the grated carrots arrive in the production hall, where the further process is taken over by the team

The company cuts and packages fresh vegetables in an innovative way and produces creative ready-to-eat meal salads for the retail and food service sector. 

• A strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail

• Technically minded and able to monitor and adjust machines

• Fluent in English

• Experience as an operator or in a production environment is a plus

A highly reliable partner for our customers around the world, we offer environmentally friendly products that increase the comfort of homes and buildings in terms of insulation, safety, acoustics and air quality.

Remuneration: 17.5605 / h + shiftnumération : 2 shifts: 1.2497 /h + 4.5 euro meal vouchers per day worked.

As an operator in the recycling department, you and your colleagues will be responsible for the following tasks:

- supply and removal of materials by forklift truck

- filling the goods

- cleaning the production lines

 

You have had technical training or already have experience working within production.

You can work on a regular 2 shifts: 6h-14h, 14h-22h or fix night shift 22h-6h

You communicate in English

You can work with a PC.

You can work with a forklift truck. A certificate can be obtained through us.

Safe and clean work is important to you

Searching for a job in Sales? Eager to learn everything from the bottom to the top?Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a highly self-motivated, results oriented and solutions driven Management Trainee with a general interest in all levels of a business and a general interest in developing new technologies. After completing the management trainee program, you will be assigned to a full-time position in Sales.

The client's management trainee program is designed for recent university graduates who are highly motivated and have the potential to excel as future global leaders at the company. The training program is customized to meet the skills of the employee along with the needs of the company.

It offers challenging work assignments along with hands on training in manufacturing, quality control, administration, sales & marketing, and logistics. You will be exposed to all areas of the business and learn by successfully completing various projects in the different departments.

• A master or bachelor degree.
• If you have already strong sales skills for new account development that would be an advantage.
• 2 years of previous work experiences.
• A fluent pen and verbal skills in English and Dutch. Any additional languages would be great.
• Able to work autonomously, in a structured and efficient way.
• Strong sense of urgency, listening, communication and organizational skills.

Apply today – we’d love to meet you!

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)

Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians. 
• Then you take care of a perfect treatment, namely washing, sorting and stocking of the potatoes. 
• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality. 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts. 
• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.

About the Job : 

On behalf of our client working in the Financial Services Industry, we are look for a Credit Risk Analyst that will help assessing project viabilities and predictive model development and optimization : 

• In credit risk model analysis and maintainance 
• Code development and code testing to put in place new predictive models into the system 
• Ensuring good communication flows with Banking regulators 
• Ad hoc research on portfolio risk evolution 

About You :

• Master in an Analytics, Statistical, or Finance oriented field 
• Well versed in Microsoft Excel, Access
• Well versed in analytical tools like Python, R, SAS…
• Analytical character and an eye for detail 
• Perfectly fluent in Dutch with a good grasp of English and French

Main Responsibilities

The Technical Sales Manager contributes annually to the development of a strategic sales plan, in consultation with management (including objectives, KPIs, segmentation, and action points). In addition, weekly consultations and monthly reporting will be required.

Building and expanding a proactive and sustainable network of customers, prospects, partners (suppliers, machine builders, ...)

In most projects, the Technical Sales Manager will act as coordinator between customers, engineering offices, partners, suppliers, and the Revimaxx team.

You continuously monitor the market and trends and also share these internally. You pay attention to developments in technologies, relationships between customers/partners, subcontracting, opportunities, ...

You are open to and contribute to active marketing support, social media communication, participation in trade fairs, training sessions, ...

In this role, a combination of technical/mechanical expertise and a sense for economic reality is necessary. This may have been built through experience, interest, education... or perhaps through a combination of these.

• Industrial Engineer, Civil Engineer, or equivalent through experience
• Initial technical sales and/or consultancy experience (with technical expertise) and demonstrable results are a must, with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
• You have a strong affinity with the machine construction sector and are passionate about the mechanical possibilities of small and large machines/systems.
• Your commercial experience motivates you to independently evaluate opportunities and pursue them.
• You are conceptually strong and enjoy thinking together with the customer in a co-creative way to arrive at the best solution for their challenge.
• You are analytical and skilled with numbers in order to quickly determine margins and feasibility of projects. You have a sense for the economic reality of each project.
• You possess strong communication skills and communicate effectively with customers, partners, and the Revimaxx team. (knowledge of perfect English, and willingness to learn Dutch quickly)
• You have a natural ambition to grow and to support the growth of Revimaxx.
• You are results-oriented, loyal, flexible, and demonstrate strong perseverance.
• You hold a valid for wheel driving licence.

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst to support the design and continuous improvement of processes and tools for both individual and professional customers in Finance/insurance.
Key responsibilities

• Business Analysis: Gather, analyze, prioritize and document business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, user stories and process flows.

• Process Optimization: Assess existing processes, identify improvement opportunities and contribute to digital transformation initiatives, including partner portals, automation and self-service solutions.

• Solution Design & Implementation: Work closely with business, IT, architecture, operations and compliance teams to design suitable solutions, support user acceptance testing (UAT) and facilitate change management.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Organize workshops and presentations, engage key stakeholders and ensure that transformation initiatives meet business objectives.

• Agile Delivery: Actively contribute to team activities, backlog management and Agile ceremonies, promoting Agile values and principles.

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst (+ 5 years).

• Bachelor in information technology, software engineering, computer science, or related field

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies, backlog management tools and team ceremonies.

• Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to understand diverse stakeholder needs while maintaining a global perspective.

• Ability to engage stakeholders, influence decisions and build commitment.

• Fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

Blue Pimento Company Profile

Dynamic Consultancy services firm with a human scale, based in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium, Blue Pimento is dedicated to development and deployment of business-oriented platforms. We help mid-sized companies in maximizing the business value of their information systems changes.

The success of Blue Pimento is based on Quality & Flexibility of the work performed by its consultants and most of the repeating assignments results from our customer's confidence.

• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently

• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.

• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to undergo in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team. If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. 
 

What you can expect: 
 

 
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.
 
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.
 
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 
 
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.
 
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities.
 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.
 

Tasks:
 

 
• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
 
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
 
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
 
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
 
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences and experience with cell culture? Would you like to contribute to groundbreaking therapies that are changing patients' lives worldwide?
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 
 

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, ...) in a controlled temperature environment.
 

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.
 

Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic
 

Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.
 

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.
 

Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site. 
 

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.
 

Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.
 

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.
 

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.
 

 
• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment
 
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas 
 

Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:
 

 
• Cell isolation
 
• Cell selection, activation, and transduction
 
• Cell culture
 
• Aseptic processing
 
• Filling and finishing operations
 
• Cryopreservation 
 

Manufacturing clinical and commercial ATMPs (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products)
 

 
• Adhering to all applicable quality and safety standards 
 

Performing in-process controls on batch samples while maintaining the highest quality standards
 

Strictly following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), batch records, and GMP guidelines
 

 
• Recording and managing GMP documentation to ensure compliance and traceability 
 

Supporting environmental monitoring and the maintenance of GMP production areas
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Who are you?
 

You are a detail-oriented team player who enjoys working in an innovative manufacturing environment.
 

You have:
 

 
• A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or an equivalent field
 
• Initial experience with cell culture
 
• Experience in a GMP environment and/or ATMP manufacturing is a strong asset
 
• Good command of English, both written and spoken
 
• Willingness to work in a shift-based system
 
• A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?
 

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.
 

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.
 

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.
 

What your day-to-day will look like:
 

 
• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
 
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
 
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
 
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
 
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
 
• Supporting transitions between production zones
 
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time 

 
• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
 
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
 
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
 
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
 
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
 
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
 
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
 
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
 
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!
 

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 
 

 
 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
 

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.
 

What You’ll Do
 

 
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
 
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
 
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
 
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
 
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients. 
 

Good to Know You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
 

 
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
 
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
 
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
 
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.
